before.description_en: Live-test candidate ITEM-032: Sintel by Blender Foundation / Durian Open Movie Project. Licence candidate CC-BY-3.0. Film-level CC BY; review original credit terms.

after.description_en: A young woman searches for the dragon she once rescued. An animated fantasy with fighting and themes of loss. © copyright Blender Foundation | www.sintel.org · CC BY 3.0 · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
after.description_ur: ایک نوجوان لڑکی اس ڈریگن کی تلاش میں نکلتی ہے جسے اس نے کبھی بچایا تھا۔ اس اینیمیٹڈ فینٹسی میں لڑائی کے مناظر اور بچھڑنے کا دکھ شامل ہے۔ © copyright Blender Foundation | www.sintel.org · CC BY 3.0 · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
after.description_roman_ur: Ek naujawan larki us dragon ki talash mein nikalti hai jisay us ne kabhi bachaya tha. Is animated fantasy mein larai ke manazir aur bichharne ka dukh shamil hai. © copyright Blender Foundation | www.sintel.org · CC BY 3.0 · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

mediaReviewEvidence.finding: Complete retained source was transcoded without trimming. Original closing credits visibly confirm Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 and www.sintel.org.

before.description_en: Live-test candidate ITEM-012: Analog television static excerpt by Caleb Minear. Licence candidate CC0-1.0. Import a short editorial trim only after rights OK — do not count multiple trims as separate items.

after.description_en: An analog television static sample with rapidly changing black-and-white patterns and a continuous hiss. Caleb Minear · CC0 1.0 · https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
after.description_ur: اینالاگ ٹیلی وژن کی اسٹیٹک کا ایک نمونہ۔ اس میں تیزی سے بدلتے سیاہ و سفید نقش اور مسلسل سرسراہٹ ہے۔ Caleb Minear · CC0 1.0 · https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
after.description_roman_ur: Analog television ki static ka ek namoona. Is mein tezi se badalte siyah-o-safaid naqsh aur musalsal sarsarahat hai. Caleb Minear · CC0 1.0 · https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
